description:
CLOÉSTAR is a Newport Beach-based family of brands designed around elevated comfort, timeless style, and intentional living. Our collections include women's fashion, children's apparel, athleisure, swimwear, and clean beauty products created for modern families who value quality, versatility, and effortless style.

What makes us different:

We believe luxury should feel comfortable and wearable. Every collection is thoughtfully designed with refined silhouettes, premium fabrics, and carefully curated colors that transition seamlessly across seasons and everyday moments.

How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn 10% commission on every qualified order. We provide affiliate links, discount codes, creative assets, and dedicated support to help maximize performance.

How to promote us:

Share your affiliate link and discount code through Instagram, TikTok, blogs, email newsletters, YouTube, Pinterest, and other social platforms. Authentic lifestyle content, product reviews, styling videos, and family-focused content perform especially well.

Other information:

We are actively building long-term partnerships with creators, moms, lifestyle influencers, fashion enthusiasts, and beauty advocates who align with our brand values. We review applications manually to ensure a strong fit and meaningful collaboration opportunities.
payout_period: Affiliate commissions are paid monthly. Approved commissions are processed after the 7-day return/refund period has passed. Payments are typically issued during the first week of each month for all eligible commissions earned in the previous month.
term_and_condition:
CLOÉSTAR + MASON TYLER COLLECTIVE TERMS & CONDITIONS

Eligibility

To be eligible for commissions, you must apply and be accepted into the CLOÉSTAR + MASON TYLER Collective program and comply with all rules outlined herein.

Participation is open to individuals who maintain active social media accounts and align with the values, aesthetic, and brand standards of CLOÉSTAR and Mason Tyler.


Commission + Rewards

Affiliates may earn:

  • 10% commission on qualified product purchases made using their unique referral link or referral Bonus per tier for new sign ups to the Balance program. 
  • 20% more to spend when converted commissionable earnings into CLOÉSTAR Balance.


10% Commissions apply to product purchases only and do not include:

  • CLOÉSTAR Balance subscription payments
  • taxes, shipping fees, or discounts
  • returned or refunded orders


Commissions are released once the customers return window has closed, and only apply to fully paid, non-returned orders where your link or code was used at checkout.

CLOÉSTAR Balance Referral Bonuses

Affiliates may earn a one-time referral bonus when a new customer subscribes to the CLOÉSTAR Balance through their unique link.

Referral Bonus by Tier:

  • Essential → $15
  • Signature → $20
  • Premier → $25


Referral Qualification Requirements

Referral bonuses will only be issued once the referred customer:

  • Remains an active paying member for a minimum of two (2) consecutive billing cycles
  • Successfully completes both billing payments

If a customer cancels, pauses, or fails payment prior to completing this period, the referral bonus will not be issued.

Abuse Prevention + Program Integrity

To maintain the integrity of the CLOÉSTAR Collective, the following activities are prohibited:

  • Creating or referring multiple accounts for the purpose of generating commissions or bonuses
  • Self-referrals or using personal accounts to generate earnings
  • Referring customers who repeatedly cancel and re-subscribe to trigger multiple bonuses
  • Sharing links or codes in unauthorized environments (including coupon, rebate, or deal sites)
  • Any fraudulent, deceptive, or manipulative activity

Each referred customer is eligible for one (1) referral bonus only, regardless of future cancellations or re-subscriptions.

CLOÉSTAR reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to determine eligibility and withhold or revoke commissions or bonuses that violate the intent of the program.

Use of Links + Codes

Affiliates are encouraged to share their link or code organically through their own content, including posts, reels, videos, and stories, in a way that aligns with their personal brand and the CLOÉSTAR + MASON TYLER aesthetic.

Referral links and discount codes are intended for your personal audience only and may not be shared on coupon, rebate, or deal aggregation sites.

If a code is leaked or shared outside approved channels:

  • It may be changed without notice
  • Repeated violations may result in removal from the program


Earnings + Payout Options

Affiliates may choose how they receive their earnings:

Cash Payout

  • Paid via PayPal or bank transfer
  • Processed on the 14th of each month (for eligible earnings)


CLOÉSTAR Balance (Preferred)

  • Convert earnings into Balance and receive 20% more to spend
  • Balance may be used across CLOÉSTAR, Mason Tyler, and CLOÉ Beauty
  • Once converted, Balance is non-transferable and non-reversible


Cookie Window + Tracking

Sales are tracked via a 14-day cookie window.

Any qualified purchase made within fourteen (14) days of a customer clicking your referral link will be attributed to your account.

Commissions are calculated on the order subtotal, excluding taxes, shipping, and returns.


Returns, Refunds + Adjustments

  • Commissions are not paid on returned or refunded orders
  • Any previously credited commissions related to returns may be:
    • deducted from future payouts
    • or reversed


Program Changes + Termination

Knapp USA LLC (dba CLOÉSTAR and Mason Tyler) reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the program at any time, including:

  • commission rates
  • referral bonuses
  • eligibility requirements
  • payout structures


We also reserve the right to remove or suspend any participant who:

  • violates these Terms
  • misrepresents the brand
  • engages in conduct inconsistent with CLOÉSTAR’s values


Upon termination for violation, all pending or unpaid commissions may be forfeited.


Content + Marketing Rights

By participating, you grant CLOÉSTAR, Mason Tyler, CLOÉ Beauty and Knapp USA LLC a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, repost, and feature your submitted or publicly shared content (including photos, videos, and captions) across marketing channels including:

  • website
  • email
  • social media
  • paid advertising


Wherever possible, credit will be given to you as the content creator.


Payments + Taxes

Affiliates are solely responsible for all applicable taxes, fees, and expenses associated with their earnings.

All commissions are calculated as a net amount before any required withholdings.


General Terms

Participation in the CLOÉSTAR Collective constitutes full acceptance of these Terms & Conditions.

Knapp USA LLC retains the right to interpret and apply these terms at its discretion and to update them at any time.
